blocks.text: Thailand’s Culture Minister Sabida Thaised on Oct. 25, 2026, rejected Cambodia’s demand for the return of artifacts, asserting that Prasat Ta Kwai and Prasat Khana, two temples along the Thai-Cambodian border, belong to Thailand. Sabida said the Culture Ministry would prepare a formal response to a letter dated Oct. 22 from Cambodia’s Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts, which raised claims and demands concerning border heritage sites and antiquities. Sabida cites Thai registration of both temples Sabida maintained that Prasat Ta Kwai and Prasat Khana had already been registered as ancient monuments under Thai law.
